messages:
zoe: Postmortem follow-up: last night's pager surge during cache reprovisioning. Need a short handoff checklist with owners, quick mitigations, and how we'll measure success.

mike: I'll take the alert audit and split by cluster + traffic class. ETA 36h.

arjun: I'll own dedupe + paging lanes. Plan: per-host cooldown 10m + cluster cooldown 25m; add a night-window routing rule (23:00-07:00) to route duplicates to #alerts-ops instead of paging unless incident_count > 3 in 15m. ETA 48h.

sara: I'll add validation queries and a dashboard: alerts/day (cache_*), night_pagers, uniq_hosts_alerting, missed-criticals. Baseline tomorrow AM. ETA 24h.

oncall-bot: Reminder: any change that affects paging must have a runbook PR in infra/runbooks and be reviewed by @eng-sre.

mike: sample quick tweak I can try behind flag for prod-eu:
```yaml
- alert: cache_p99_high
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(cache_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, cluster)) > 160
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
I'll parameterize cluster thresholds.

arjun: PD dedupe idea: dedupe_key = host+alertname, then add a filter that promotes to page only if open_incidents_for_host_last_15m == 0. else post as info. Will draft PD rule.

sara: metrics to track + success target: reduce night_pagers by 70% in two weeks with no rise in missed_criticals. I'll post baseline by 09:00 PT tomorrow.

zoe: owners recap: mike -> alert audit & PR (36h), arjun -> dedupe + PD lanes (48h), sara -> dashboard & baseline (24h). Quick check-in Mon 10:00 PT. Post short updates only.

oncall-bot: Auto: please add runbook PR when ready.
